title: Credit Department Settings: Consigned Exposure on VendPoint Substitute Settling Pars
content:
Credit department settings for the settling par of a Corbett-placed substitute on a VendPoint Industrial Vending Program machine, read from the customer's Commercial Credit Account.

The consigned exposure factor follows the customer's open Commercial Credit Account, the account with no closed date: when that account's status is on hold or in collections, or two or more payments were returned on the customer's account in the twelve months ending today, the factor is the restricted exposure factor; when the account's status is active and exactly one payment was returned in those twelve months, the factor is the watch exposure factor; otherwise the factor is one; returned payments are counted by return date.

Whole months between two dates are counted as the difference in calendar months, less one when the day of the month of the later date is before the day of the month of the earlier date; a record counts in a stated number of months ending today when fewer whole months than that number, counted this way, separate its date from today.

| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Restricted exposure factor (on hold, in collections, or 2 or more returned payments) | 0.5 |
| Watch exposure factor (active, exactly 1 returned payment) | 0.8 |
| Any other open account | 1 |

Hypothetical dates, today 31 March: a payment returned on 1 April of the year before is eleven whole months back and counts; one returned on 31 March of the year before is twelve whole months back and does not.
